epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
requirements: R1: Provide a docker-compose.yml at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Add Docker Compose setup for local stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization setup for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml file, so that the full stack can be started and verified locally.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When I run `docker-compose up`, Then the backend, frontend, and database start successfully.
Given the running stack, When I ping the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a success status.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Local development and verification environment availability
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup and launch time from a manual multi-step process to 1 command

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
requirements: R1: Support updating and deleting existing epidemiological materials from the UI, invoking existing API endpoints.

slices.title: Implement UI controls for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing material updates for this epic, I want to add UI controls for editing and deleting, so that the catalog can be accurately maintained.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user clicks edit and saves changes, Then the frontend sends a PUT request and updates the view.
Given an existing material, When a user clicks delete, Then the frontend sends a DELETE request and removes it from the view.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Frontend capability for material lifecycle management
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase material catalog accuracy by allowing 100% of outdated entries to be updated or deleted

epics.title: Knowledge Base Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents to 0% by enforcing authentication across all restricted endpoints and views
epics.tocConstraintRef: System security and access control mechanism
requirements: R1: Enforce authentication for accessing the catalog and creating materials, prompting unauthenticated users to log in.

slices.title: Enforce authentication for restricted views and actions
slices.jtbd: When implementing the authentication mechanism for this epic, I want to integrate login prompts and route protection, so that unauthorized users cannot view or modify the catalog.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to view the catalog, Then they are redirected to a login prompt.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then they are blocked from performing the action.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Frontend route protection and API interceptor logic
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test coverage for authentication intercepts on the catalog and material creation routes
